ConnectionStrings._comment: Provided at runtime via the ConnectionStrings__DefaultConnection environment variable. Never commit a real database password here. Local development uses appsettings.Development.json (the docker-compose Postgres).

Clients._comment: Shared secret every kiosk client must present to connect to the SignalR hub and the client-facing API endpoints. Supplied in production via the Clients__SharedSecret environment variable; leave blank locally to allow anonymous clients. Distribute the same value to each client as LANYARD_CLIENT_SHARED_SECRET.

VideoStreaming._comment: ICE servers for cross-client video streaming. Empty = STUN fallback in the browser. To relay through a TURN server (needed when direct peer-to-peer is blocked), add e.g. { "Urls": ["turn:<server-ip>:3478"], "Username": "user", "Credential": "pass" }.

Email._comment: Resend (https://resend.com) transactional email settings for new-user invite and course-recurrence-reminder emails. ResendApiKey is provided at runtime via the Email__ResendApiKey environment variable in production. FromAddress must be on a domain verified in Resend (SPF/DKIM/DMARC records added at your DNS provider) - see appsettings.local.json for local dev values, e.g. Resend's unverified-domain test sender onboarding@resend.dev. PublicBaseUrl is the site's externally-reachable base URL (e.g. https://lanyard.example.com/), used only by background-service-triggered emails that have no live request/circuit to build a link from.

_otelComment: Logs/traces/metrics export to the self-hosted Seq instance (see deploy/seq/docker-compose.yml) via the standard OpenTelemetry env vars, e.g. OTEL_EXPORTER_OTLP_ENDPOINT=http://<home-server-ip>:5341 and OTEL_EXPORTER_OTLP_PROTOCOL=grpc. Unset locally, export is simply unreachable and has no effect on app behavior.
